test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: She had seen public executions before, but this one would hant her for ears to come.
She had seen public exsecutions before, but this one would haunt her for years to come.
She had seen public executions before, but this one would haunt her for years to come.
She had seen public executions before, but this one would hawnt her for years to come.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"haunt"** means to frequently visit or appear in the form of a ghost; to continually cause distress or anxiety. (सताना, भूत के रूप में बार-बार आना)

 
 
• **Example: **The old house was said to be** haunted** by the spirits of those who had lived there centuries ago.
 
 
 
• **"Execution" **refers to the carrying out of a sentence of death on a condemned person; the process of carrying out a plan or course of action. (फांसी, कार्यान्वयन)
 
 
• **Example: **The **execution** of the plan was flawless, leading to the project's success.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hant **(सताना): Incorrect spelling of "haunt".

 
 
• **Example:** The memory of the accident would hant her for years to come. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Exsecutions **(फांसी): Incorrect spelling of "executions".
 
 
• **Example: **The exsecutions were carried out in the early hours of the morning. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Hawnt** (सताना): Incorrect spelling of "haunt".
 
 
• **Example:** The ghost would hawnt the old mansion. (Incorrect)
 
 

 

36:T507,The correct answer is **Option 2**.
